name: intraservice-telegram-bot
description: Self-hosted Telegram interface for IntraService with safe confirmations, templates and batch closing

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node --no-warnings test/self-test.mjs && node --no-warnings test/api-beta-self-test.mjs && node --no-warnings test/api-close-recovery-self-test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run validate -- --examples
